hero_description: MS Bioengineering at Columbia. I work across genomics pipelines, Medicare-scale outcomes research, EEG/brain–computer interfaces, and hardware — the full arc from model to bench to population data.
about_paragraphs: I'm a biomedical engineering graduate student at Columbia. My background spans automated genomic pipelines and molecular dynamics, large-scale CMS Medicare analysis, EEG signal processing, and building things that move — quadruped robots, nanobot navigation concepts, and the occasional walking pipeline debug at 2 a.m.

Outside the lab I'm a lead at Nucleate New York and care about the gap between a promising innovation and one that actually reaches patients. This site is projects, writing, and the occasional dream journal — navigate with the tabs, the planets, or scroll.
